newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas up in June - CVM.
newsitem.headline: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas up in June - CVM.

text.p: Net foreign capital inflows into Brazilian stock exchanges under Annex Four rules totalled $555.32 million in June, up from $510.03 million in the previous month, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said.
Foreign buys were $3.829 billion, while foreign sales totalled $3.274 billion, it said in a statement.
In the first half, net foreign investment amounted to $3.965 billion, more than all of last year's total foreign investment which reached $3.593 billion.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazilian stocks, debentures and privatization bonds.
